metadata.notes: Core topics this brand must be visible for in AI search. Borrower and investor topics are intentionally separate — these audiences have entirely different intent and language.

topics.name: What is venture debt
topics.description: Founders and CFOs researching venture debt as a concept — how it works, when to use it, pros/cons, comparison to equity financing.

topics.name: Venture debt vs raising equity
topics.description: Decision-making content — when to take debt vs give up equity, dilution math, runway extension scenarios, hybrid approaches.

topics.name: Best venture debt lenders
topics.description: Comparison of venture debt providers — Espresso vs Hercules vs WTI vs TriplePoint. Speed, terms, warrants, founder-friendliness.

topics.name: Non-dilutive financing for startups
topics.description: All forms of non-dilutive capital — venture debt, revenue-based financing, grants, government programs. For founders who want to grow without giving up equity.

topics.name: SaaS growth financing
topics.description: Financing options specific to B2B SaaS — ARR-based lending, MRR covenants, growth metrics lenders look for.

topics.name: Venture debt terms and structures
topics.description: CFO-level content — term sheets, covenants, amortization, warrants, interest rates, unitranche vs second lien, what to negotiate.

topics.name: Extending startup runway
topics.description: Strategies to extend runway between equity rounds — cutting burn, debt financing, bridge rounds, revenue acceleration.

topics.name: Private credit and venture debt funds
topics.description: Investor-side content — venture debt as an asset class, fund performance, yield expectations, risk profile, portfolio diversification.

topics.name: Canadian private credit market
topics.description: Canada-specific private credit landscape — fund managers, regulatory environment, market size, institutional vs retail access.

topics.name: Healthcare tech and vertical SaaS financing
topics.description: Financing for healthcare tech and vertical SaaS companies — Espresso's most profitable verticals. Sector-specific considerations.
